displayTitle: ページ3 トッピングを選ぶ

sentences.reading: トッピングを えらぶ
sentences.note: 選ぶ means to choose or select.

sentences.japanese: トッピングは何がありますか？
sentences.reading: トッピングは なにが ありますか？
sentences.note: 何がありますか asks what exists or is available.
sentences.romaji: Toppingu wa nani ga arimasu ka?

sentences.japanese: はいよ！定番はこんな感じだね。
sentences.reading: はいよ！ていばんは こんな かんじだね。
sentences.english: Sure! The standard ones are like this.
sentences.note: 定番 means the standard, classic, or usual option.
sentences.romaji: Hai yo! Teiban wa konna kanji da ne.

sentences.japanese: じゃあ、味玉とチャーシューをお願いします。
sentences.reading: じゃあ、あじたまと チャーシューを おねがいします。
sentences.english: Then, seasoned egg and chashu pork, please.
sentences.note: と connects nouns: A and B.
sentences.romaji: Jaa, ajitama to chashu o onegai shimasu.

sentences.japanese: お待たせ！ラーメン、味玉、チャーシュー！
sentences.reading: おまたせ！ラーメン、あじたま、チャーシュー！
sentences.english: Thanks for waiting! Ramen with seasoned egg and chashu!
sentences.note: お待たせ is short for お待たせしました, said when bringing something after a wait.
Said before eating to express gratitude for the meal.

vocabulary.note: A ramen topping, usually marinated soft-boiled egg.
Seasoned bamboo shoots used in ramen.
Adjective stem + そう means it looks or seems that way.
